title: fix: resume pollinations.ai deploys on production pushes
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: Restored the Cloudflare website deployment workflow’s push trigger on production, reversing the pause in #16121. Manual deployment through workflow_dispatch remains available. A main → production promotion that includes this workflow will automatically deploy website v2 to pollinations.ai.

The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small-to-medium in the scene, with chunky retro sprites, a warm cream and pastel-gradient background, and cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes.
